extDesc.message: Wukong Bookmark Sync xbel-ByWebdav - Sync bookmarks across browsers via WebDAV with XBEL format, supports E2E encryption

labelEncPass.message: Encryption Password (optional, enables AES-256-GCM encryption for cloud data)

statusReady.message:
Ready — Shared Mode
• Daily use → click 'Sync to Cloud'
• New device → click 'Restore from Cloud'

footerInfo.message:
Shared Mode: local or cloud, one side is the source of truth.
• Sync to Cloud: push local bookmarks to cloud
• Restore from Cloud: pull cloud bookmarks to local
• Safety threshold: reject push if local < 10% of cloud
• Encryption optional: AES-256-GCM if encryption password set
• Use Floccus if you need 'Merge Mode'
• Works alongside browser's native bookmark sync
